TRIGGERED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION:
local filter = ClearFilter() local effectController = EffectController() filter:Add( FE_SUBTYPE, OP_IS, LAND_TYPE_SWAMP ) filter:SetZone( ZONE_LIBRARY, effectController ) effectController:SetItemCount( 1 ) for i = 0, (1-1) do effectController:SetItemPrompt(i, "CARD_QUERY_CHOOSE_SWAMP_TO_PUT_INTO_HAND" ) end
effectController:ChooseItems( EffectDC():Make_Targets(0) )

local numPlayers = MTG():GetNumberOfPlayers() for i = 0, (numPlayers-1) do local player = MTG():GetNthPlayer(i)
if player ~= EffectController() then player:RevealDCToMe( EffectDC():Get_Targets(0) ) end end
local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if target ~= nil then target:PutInHand() end
